Select exact IC50 activity rows for compounds tested against human dipeptidyl peptidase-4 (CHEMBL284). Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, then to assays on assay_id, then to target_dictionary on tid. Join docs on activities.doc_id to obtain pubmed_id or doi. Join compound_structures on molregno to retrieve canonical_smiles. Left join compound_records on activities.record_id to fetch compound_key. Filter by target chembl_id CHEMBL284 and standard_type IC50, requiring pubmed_id or doi to be present. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Keep all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
